ns2:section.sectionText: Math 347 is restricted to Mathematics and Math/CS majors until the morning of April 29, 2016. Contact mathadvising@illinois.edu if you have questions. Math minors may attempt to register for this class on April 29, 2016; however admission to the minor does not guarantee a seat in any math course. Students completing Math 241 and hoping to transfer to a mathematics major should make an appointment with a math advisor during early registration. Some seats are reserved for math transfer students and will not be released until late August..
